findings.claim: No test covers the openviking-sync action's credential step. The lab-auth action has test_action_shape, which pins mask-before-export, no secret-named inputs and no `secrets.`. The new action.yml has no counterpart. Nothing would catch a later edit that drops an `::add-mask::`, moves a mask after first use, writes AWS_* or the JWT to $GITHUB_ENV or $GITHUB_OUTPUT, or changes the role ARN shape (`arn:aws:iam::role/<role>`) or the `ci-` default prefix that has to match oidc.tf and services.tf. Add a static shape test next to the sync.py tests.
